title: Exceptional sets for compositions involving Euler's function,the divisor-sum function and Dedekind's function
summary: Let \(ψ(n)\), \(φ(n)\), and \(σ(n)\) denote Dedekind's arithmetic function, Euler's totient function, and the sum-of-divisors function, respectively. We study exceptional sets associated with the compositions \(φ(ψ(n))\), \(φ(σ(n))\), \(ψ(ψ(n))\), and \(ψ(σ(n))\). For every fixed \(c>0\), we obtain quantitative upper bounds for the numbers of integers \(n\le x\) satisfying \(φ(ψ(n))\ge cn\) and \(φ(σ(n))\ge cn\), thereby refining density results of Sándor and Dixit and Bhattacharjee, respectively.
